Looking for a porta cabin in Kochi? SAMAN manufactures steel porta cabins and ships them ready-to-use to sites across Kochi and Ernakulam from our Bangalore factory. The road distance is about 550 km, so a finished unit usually reaches your site in 4 to 6 days. You get a single-room steel cabin â€” site office, security post, rest room, or store â€” built to size, wired, and finished before it leaves the factory. No on-site construction, no masonry delays in Kerala’s wet weather.

SAMAN has been making prefab steel structures since 2009 and runs two factories â€” Bangalore for South India and Greater Noida for the North. Kochi is served fully from Bangalore, and as a direct porta cabin manufacturer we control the steel, the panels, and the finish in-house â€” so what we quote is what we build.

Why buyers in Kochi choose SAMAN

Kochi is a port and project city. Cochin Port, the Vallarpadam terminal, the shipyard work, the construction along the metro corridor, the IT parks at Infopark Kakkanad â€” all of it needs movable, weather-tight workspace that goes up fast and comes down clean. A porta cabin gives you exactly that without tying up land or pouring a permanent slab for a temporary need.

Kerala’s monsoon is the real test, and it is where prefab beats site-built. A SAMAN cabin arrives sealed, insulated, and roofed for heavy rain â€” no waiting for plaster to dry between downpours. We build to order, sized for your site, finished in your colour, and fitted with the points and windows you need. SAMAN holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certification, with 500+ projects delivered across India. Browse the porta cabin models we build to this standard.

Local industries in Kochi that use porta cabins

Kochi’s demand is spread across the port, the IT belt, and the construction corridors:

  • Infopark and the Kakkanad IT corridor (682030) â€” developers and IT firms use porta cabins as site offices and security cabins during campus fit-outs.
  • Cochin Port and Vallarpadam (682009) â€” logistics and freight operators use them as gate offices, weighbridge cabins, and supervisor rooms.
  • Eloor–Edayar industrial belt (683501) â€” chemical and engineering units use them as shift-supervisor offices and store rooms.
  • NH-66 and the metro corridor â€” construction contractors use them as on-site project offices that relocate as the work moves through the city.

For any site from Kakkanad to Willingdon Island, a single truck delivers and places the cabin in a day.

Specifications and sizes

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built on a welded MS steel frame using IS 2062 grade hollow sections. The standard build:

  • Frame: mild steel hollow section, welded and anti-rust treated â€” important in Kochi’s salt-air coastal climate
  • Wall panels: PUF insulated sandwich panel or cement fibre board
  • Roof: GI sheet or colour-coated profile sheet with a steeper slope for heavy monsoon runoff
  • Flooring: marine ply, cement board, or vinyl over a steel base
  • Doors and windows: powder-coated steel or aluminium, sealed against rain ingress

Sizes run from a compact 6Ã—8 ft security cabin up to 20Ã—8 ft and 40Ã—8 ft office units, with multi-room layouts available. For the full construction detail and finish options, see the steel porta cabin product page â€” the build most Kochi site offices use. Any size in between is made to order.

Customisation options

Tell us how the cabin will be used and we build around it:

  • Split AC points and extra power sockets for office use
  • Internal partitions for a separate cabin or meeting room
  • Toilet and washbasin block built into the unit
  • Glass front for a reception, sales, or gate cabin
  • Loft storage above the ceiling line
  • Sealed, anti-skid flooring for wet coastal sites

Price guidance

A porta cabin price in Kochi depends on four things: the size, the wall panel (cement board is economical, PUF panel insulates better and suits the coastal climate), the interior fit-out, and the transport distance to your exact site. Because every unit is made to order, we confirm a firm price at quotation once we know your size and use â€” no add-ons after.

Delivery and installation to Kochi

Your cabin is built and finished at our Bangalore factory, then trucked to Kochi via the Salem–Coimbatore–Thrissur route â€” typically 4 to 6 days from dispatch. Smaller units arrive fully assembled and are craned into position in a few hours. Larger or multi-room units arrive in sections and are bolted together on site by our team. You need a level base ready before delivery â€” a plinth, a concrete pad, or compacted ground that drains well in the rain.

We serve all of South India from the same Bangalore factory. If you are weighing up a nearby site, you can also see our porta cabin in Hyderabad and porta cabin in Madurai pages.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a porta cabin cost in Kochi?

The price depends on size, panel type, and fit-out. A small gate cabin costs far less than a fully fitted office unit. We confirm the exact figure at quotation once we know your requirement.

How long does delivery to Kochi take?

Usually 4 to 6 days from dispatch out of our Bangalore factory, since the road distance is about 550 km.

Do porta cabins hold up in Kochi’s monsoon?

Yes. The units arrive sealed and insulated with a sloped, water-tight roof and rain-sealed doors and windows, built for heavy coastal rain.

Can the porta cabin be moved later?

Yes. It is a bolted steel structure â€” it can be lifted, loaded, and relocated when your site work moves.

What sizes are available?

From a 6Ã—8 ft single cabin up to 40Ã—8 ft office units and larger multi-room layouts, all made to order.

Get a quote for your porta cabin in Kochi

Tell us your size, use, and site location and we will send a clear quote. For Bangalore and South India, call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440, or send an enquiry through the form and our team will get back to you.
